planets.name: TOI-1468 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1468 with a 15.5-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1468 c was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1468. Its orbit and size follow Meier Valdés et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
